estimates.assumptions: 1 large orange (approx 280g whole fruit with peel); edible portion after trimming top/bottom and seeds is nearly the full weight as puree includes peel
300g caster sugar (all used in the batter)
75ml olive oil (all incorporated into the batter)
1 tbs (approx 12g) baking powder; modest contribution from typical powder
4 large eggs (approx 200g total edible portion without shells; all used raw in batter)
2 tsp (approx 8-10g) vanilla extract; modest contribution from typical extract
